title: Learn about construction impacts to transit and transportation on-Island

paragraphs: Information about current transit and transportation impacts associated with ongoing Treasure and Yerba Buena Islands construction activities.

sections.heading: MUNI 25 bus route and stop changes
paragraphs: The MUNI 25-Treasure Island bus route and stops change due to construction and traffic re-routing on both Treasure and Yerba Buena Islands.
Find current MUNI-25 route, stop and schedule information.

sections.heading: Street closures - Treasure Island
paragraphs: Current Treasure Island streets closed to vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists are:
Clipper Cove Ave. closed between Seven Seas Ave. and Avenue H
Avenue H closed between 4th St. and 9th St.
Avenue M closed between 10th St. and 13th St.

sections.heading: Street closures and traffic detours - Yerba Buena Island
paragraphs: Learn about ongoing Yerba Buena Island detours in place through 2027 .
Current Yerba Buena Island streets closed to vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists are:
Treasure Island Road closed south of Macalla Road
Hillcrest Road closed between TI Road and Forest Road Detour Road
